meta.multimedia_contract: image-text | image-audio [+ text] | video [+ text]; native Intake unchanged
meta.video_policy: Three sequential frames; valid uncertain frames continue; conflicting or invalid observations are saved for review.
meta.knowledge_contract: POST /knowledge; native JSON and v4_grounded unchanged; receipt headers are integration-only
meta.knowledge_scope: Commune de Tunis (user confirmed); no missing report location is inferred
meta.knowledge_gate: Actual indexed context and conservative verbatim support; paraphrases, refusals, deadlines or unverified evidence require REVIEW
meta.review_policy: Usable uncertainty continues to RAG; quality decisions retained; every outcome persists as a ticket/status.
